messages:
sophie: FYI customers A & C reported intermittent 502s to /v1/generate around 09:37-09:43 UTC. Error rate jumped from ~0.2% to ~8% for a ~6m window. Attaching the small snippet we got from a repro and the edge logs.

raj: can you paste a sample request/response and any envoy/edge log lines? helps triage.

sophie: here's a representative curl we used and the host log lines.
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-lite","input":"hello"}' \n```

Edge log excerpt:
```
[09:37:12] edge-proxy: upstream read timeout (502) -> upstream=hosting-billing-1 tenant=acme req_id=abc123
[09:37:12] envoy: connection reset by upstream (billing-queue)
[09:37:13] edge-proxy: retried 1/2 -> upstream_reset
```

sophie: sample client-facing error: `{\"error\":\"gateway_error\",\"status\":502,\"message\":\"upstream connection reset\"}`

deploy-bot: deploy event: billing/dispatcher v2 deployed at 09:36:18 UTC by luis (sha: d4f7b2)

luis: rolled out a change to the billing dispatcher to switch to synchronous balance checks + batched invoicing. It started at 09:36 and pushed a short-lived fanout to billing-db, which may have coincided with the spike. I can roll back if we suspect causal.

maya: quick observations from SRE: we see a coordinated spike in short-lived DB connections from billing-dispatcher that overlapped with heavy small-request load on hosted inference. Upstream (billing) latencies spiked, causing edge backend pool to stall and return resets.

maya: immediate mitigation suggestions:
- throttle billing dispatcher concurrency for the next hour (set max_workers=4)
- temporarily increase proxy upstream_read_timeout to 30s for /v1/generate route
- add a short retry (1 retry with jitter) on gateway for 502s from billing path

raj: repro steps I used locally (worked reproducibly):
```bash
# background: hammer embeddings endpoint while triggering billing job
for i in {1..500}; do 
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/embeddings -d '{"input":"x"}' &
done
# then trigger billing dispatch via admin endpoint
curl -s -X POST https://ops-internal/dispatch-billing
```
Expect to see ~5-10% 502s within 30s of dispatch.

sophie: filed a customer update and set ETA "we're investigating, mitigation in progress". Also opening a formal incident. Linking the traces: https://observability.redwood.example/trace/abc123

ingress-bot: alert created: I-2026-502-BILLINGFANOUT, severity=high, runbook=/runbooks/edge-502-upstream-latency

luis: rolling dispatcher back to v1 now to avoid further customer impact. Will report once complete.

maya: after rollback we're seeing error rate fall back to baseline over next 2m. keeping an eye on edge pool. If stable for 15m we can close this.

sophie: thanks all — I'll update the tickets and follow up with a postmortem checklist (config diff, DB connection profile, and dispatcher concurrency settings). :thumbsup:
